name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes the invisible Federation settings page (0.0.82 shipped with a page that never renders). Root cause: /web/ConfigurationPage (DashboardController.FileStreamResult) returns corrupted gzip/br bodies — the compressed bytes are later read as UTF-8 and re-encoded, replacing non-UTF-8 bytes with U+FFFD so the file starts 1f ef bf bd instead of 1f 8b 08 (ERR_CONTENT_DECODING_FAILED in every browser, while /Plugins/Federation/Config via ContentResult compressed correctly); verified live with python http.client and Playwright at 192.168.7.47:8096. A middleware now forces identity for /web/ConfigurationPage so the page actually loads. Also fixes DedupProviderIds ballooning to 84 entries (28× the default) from repeated saves without de-duplication — now normalised to unique lowercase on save and cleaned on startup — and preserves MigratedContainerV11 across saves (would have re-triggered a full item rebuild on every save). Redesigned the settings UI: hero header with icon, pill segmented tabs with icons, 3-step onboarding, card sections, animated status tiles, polished pills/callouts, and avatar initials. 223 tests.
